entities.name: Urdom
entities.description: A warrior and alleged hydra-slayer of Tazeem who hired out as a guide across the Teeth of Akoum and was killed by rock lizards.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: Planeswalker guided by Urdom across the Teeth of Akoum.

entities.description: Creatures that attacked Urdom and Chandra.

events.summary: Sachir hires Urdom to guide Chandra Nalaar across the Teeth of Akoum to Anowon's camp for one gold coin.
events.quote: He was hired by Sachir to guide Chandra Nalaar across the Teeth of Akoum to Anowon 's camp for a single gold coin.

events.summary: Fire-breathing rock lizards attack Urdom and Chandra on the trek and Urdom is killed.
events.quote: he and Chandra were attacked by fire-breathing rock lizards , and Urdom was killed.
